findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "gaip_watch_list" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "integration-protocol" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_agent_conformance, gaip_observatory_lookup, gaip_tools_changed_since, gaip_check_permission · Private data: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_remove, gaip_observatory_capture, gaip_check_permission, gaip_compare_supplier_snapshots, gaip_diagnose_integration_failure · Public sink: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_events · Destructive: gaip_watch_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_agent_conformance, gaip_observatory_lookup, gaip_tools_changed_since, gaip_check_permission · Private data: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_remove, gaip_observatory_capture, gaip_check_permission, gaip_compare_supplier_snapshots, gaip_diagnose_integration_failure · Public sink: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_events · Destructive: gaip_watch_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
